_provenance.note: Nevada citation authorities. DSS publishes ONE combined Eligibility and Payments (E&P) Manual shared across TANF/SNAP/other programs, split into three lettered Parts: Part A — Determining Eligibility (chapters 100–2600), Part B — Case Management (chapters 100–1400), and Part C — Charts/dollar tables (chapters 100–300). All three are cited in the manual's own cross-references and in this pack's prose as 'E&P MS A-NNN' / 'E&P MS B-NNN' / 'E&P MS C-NNN'; the regexes below match the bare 'A-NNN'/'B-NNN'/'C-NNN' form since that is what appears at the top of every page and what the manual's own internal cross-references use. Amendments issue as numbered Manual Transmittal Letters (MTLs, e.g. 'MTL 21/25') printed in every chapter's footer. NRS = Nevada Revised Statutes, the Legislature's own codified law (leg.state.nv.us), used here for the drug-felony opt-out (NRS 422A.345) and the ABAWD state-discretionary-exemption statute (NRS 422A.339), both outside the E&P Manual itself.
